description: Look up Italian comuni by name (case- and accent-insensitive, partial names work) and get each one's 6-digit ISTAT code, province and region — the code get_comune needs. Returns identifiers only, no figures. Several comuni share a name; check the province before choosing.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1–25. Default 10.

q.description: A comune name or part of one, accents optional — e.g. "Introdacqua" or "reggio".

name: search_comuni

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

results.description: Best matches first: exact name, then names starting with the query, then names containing it. Several Italian comuni share a name — check the province before picking one.

istatCode.description: 6-digit ISTAT comune code — pass this to GET /comuni/{istatCode} or get_comune.

page.description: The comune's profile page on expatliving.it.

truncated.description: True when more comuni matched than `limit` allowed — narrow the query.

title: Find a comune by name
